data.one_liner: A Flutter plugin to send your app to the background easily.
data.what_it_does: Provides a simple method to programmatically send your Flutter application to the background on Android and iOS devices. It is mostly used when you want to keep your app running in the background.
use_when: You want to programmatically send the app to the background from a button press or event.
You need to keep the app running in the background on mobile platforms.
avoid_when: You need background services or task execution rather than just minimizing the app UI.
You are targeting platforms other than Android and iOS.
strengths: Extremely simple API with a single core method.
weaknesses: Very limited functionality beyond sending the app to the background.
Platform support is restricted to Android and iOS.
